designComparison.verdict: No tier bar violation against main for either (any floor). Lexicographic (tier 1 first): B ranks first, T1 0.935 / T2 0.845 / G8 0.58 of A, tolerance 0.5%. B is slower than A on map-heavy lazy pipes (with the clean-rotation floors 13 tier 1 and 6 tier 2 entries, up to 1.31x), the share of map-callback-as-evaluator. Both regress Vue reactive-array tracking through the indexed loops (pipe-array-index-loop, single-array-index-loop).
